import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,re
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.10782',routes=['361895'],destination='sources/forest-orderings-2402.10782.pdf',source_identity='Aboulker, Aubian and Lopes, Finding forest-orderings of tournaments is NP-complete, arXiv 2402.10782',purpose='Read the approximation conjecture and preceding results for target 361895')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-tourn.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-tourn.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('guard exit',r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-500:]); print(r.stderr[-500:])
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/forest-orderings-2402.10782.pdf','-'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf8','replace')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'text/forest-orderings.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('text writer',w.returncode,len(t))
t2=re.sub(r' {2,}',' ',t)
print(t2[:5000])
for m in re.finditer(r'(?i)conjecture|approximat',t2):
    if m.start()>5000: print('---',m.start(),t2[max(0,m.start()-200):m.start()+350].replace('\n',' '))
